summary: Nitter is a self‑hosted, privacy‑focused front‑end for X that runs as a Nim web service exposing both an HTTP API and a web UI. It can be installed via pip in under half a minute and requires no API key. It suits users who want to browse X without tracking but offers little novelty over the original Nitter and shows no measurable speed benefit. Its strong community and easy integration are offset by failing test suites and modest performance gains.
